host_boundary: Complete original Artist alpha methods with real numbers.Real; pchanged is a controlled stage observer, not a GUI callback API. Complete original solid/no-marker Line.draw with rasterization decorator excluded, already transformed numeric Path storage and GC/renderer presentation sinks. Native mutable RGBA cache warm-order is an independent private-state profile, not a public cache protocol.

typed_boundaries.setter: None/Double only, exact optional-value and signed-zero storage. Controlled mark_drawn supplies native clean-stale input. Row20 private detach matches explicit ownerNone without clearing cache/ranges.
typed_boundaries.pchanged: All original observer stages remain evidence; no public GUI callback protocol or arbitrary callback atomicity is added.
typed_boundaries.cache: Four original native cache warm-order observations remain source-only with exact bits unchanged. Portable derived RGBA uses current override sign without cloning the mutable global cache; raw alpha getter bits are separately strict.
typed_boundaries.draw: Actual Panel.prepare_line and returned completion project the five native solid/no-marker draw cases, including hidden noop completion and only-success completion after possible failures. No fixture alpha/empty/visibility rendering branch is supplied.
typed_boundaries.errors: Artist/color InvalidTicks uses complete native type-prefixed messages. The established D39 shape-error mapping retains exact native message without a ValueError wrapper.
typed_boundaries.style: Private source String RGBA override is tested directly. Legacy CSS stroke-opacity composition and existing Rgba.to_css formatting are convenience profiles, not native CSS/viewer parity.
